control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: corrective action following learning team review at HT-9001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on HT-9001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling traffic on operating areas, specifically applying positive communication before approach. HT-9001 (haul trucks) is in service for waste and ore haulage. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 2 January 2024 a corrective action on HT-9001 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
